factual_claims.claim: North and Latin American quarterly turnover decreased 40% to EUR 2.5 million, while European turnover increased 24% to EUR 1.9 million and turnover in Asia, Africa and the Middle East doubled to EUR 846 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The turnover of the North America and Latin America region amounted to 47% or EUR 2.5 million. Compared to the same quarter of the previous financial year, the turnover has decreased by 40%. European region accounted for 36% of turnover, amounting to EUR 1.9 million, an increase of 24%... Asia, Africa and the Middle East region doubled compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, representing 16% of the total quarterly turnover (or EUR 846 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: Management noted that quarterly results are affected by the timing and complexity of individual projects, production processes, material procurement and the subsequent recognition of revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Fluctuations in quarterly turnover are influenced by the completion of individual projects. Projects can vary in scope and complexity, and their execution is influenced by both the duration of the production process and the lead times for material procurement. As a result, the dispatch of goods and the recognition of revenue often take place only in subsequent quarters.

factual_claims.claim: Operations continued to be affected by the global shortage of electronic components.

factual_claims.claim: The Group had accumulated material reserves to meet orders and maintain short delivery times, and reported that delivery times had recently improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: During the previous period, the company accumulated material reserves to be able to fulfill the majority of orders, ensuring short, or customer-expected, delivery times. Delivery times have continued to improve recently.

factual_claims.claim: Inventories increased 8% to EUR 13.94 million, reflecting the need to maintain product and service-related component reserves.
